WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 699, Lot 27 as shown on the Tax Map of New York, Borough of Manhattan (the “Tax Map"), and as more particularly described in Exhibit I attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Granting Site"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 692, Lot 53 (Lot 53") and Block 692, Lot 57 ("Lot 57") as shown on the Tax Map, and as more particularly described in Exhibit I attached hereto and made a part hereof (collectively the "Receiving Parcel"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Site is a “granting site” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “Zoning Resolution"); and WHEREAS, part of the Receiving Parcel is a “receiving site” as defined in Section 98- 33 of the Zoning Resolution, as more particularly described in Exhibit II (hereinafter the "Receiving Site"); and WHEREAS, certain “floor area,” as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, allowable for the development of the Granting Site is unused and is available for transfer under Section98-30oftheZoningResolution; and WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have notified the New York City Department of City Planning ("DCP") of their intent to transfer one thousand eight hundred eighty-six (1,886) square feet of the floor area from the Granting Site to the Receiving Site (the “Receiving Site Rights"); and WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 98-60 of the Zoning Resolution an Access Easement Volume Agreement establishing a primary access easement on Block 699 was recorded in the Office of the City Register for New York County on August 4, 2014, at CRFN #2014000255149; and WHEREAS, Transferor and Transferee desire to transfer the Receiving Site Rights to the Receiving Site. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreement herein contained, it is hereby agreed as follows:
